observedVersusInferred.denominators: Aligned counter basis and positive driving denominator; weekday helper pairs only share-eligible same-day numerators/denominators. Null remains null; measured zero requires unchanged FSD observation.
observedVersusInferred.populations: Top days positive-only capped10; contributing positive attributed completed-inside-period contract; groups high-confidence/repeated routes>=2; distinct firmware/efficiency/monthly populations. Observatory truncation announced. Frontend declarations do not prove backend population construction.
observedVersusInferred.rawSI: Meters and Wh remain raw in hooks/cache/custom exports; chart rows convert at display. Efficiency duplicates conversion ownership (F06), not a claimed magnitude defect.
observedVersusInferred.signs: Signed distance/share/efficiency differences preserved; central distance formatter does not discard negative differences.
observedVersusInferred.provenance: Historical request provenance and normalization guard are source declarations, not live assurances. Fetch updatedAt is not observation time.
